title: Shopper Pay Schedule Note — The Amount Claimed on a Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage Dispute
content:
**Clause.** The amount claimed on a mileage dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch is the mileage owed on the paid route less the mileage pay standing on the batch, rounded once to the cent half up and never below zero, and it is claimed only when the miles driven exceed the estimated route by more than the mileage dispute tolerance. The paid route is the estimated route plus the miles driven beyond the estimated route grown by the tolerance, less the batch type's included miles, and the mileage owed on it is the batch type's mileage rate per mile. The mileage pay standing is the batch's posted mileage pay less the reversals booked on the batch on the verified not-delivered ground.

## The quantities, defined

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Tolerance | The batch type's mileage dispute tolerance, a percentage |
| Estimated route grown by the tolerance | The estimated route multiplied by one plus the tolerance percentage |
| Qualifying test | The miles driven (GPS) are greater than the grown estimate; otherwise nothing is claimed |
| Miles beyond the grown estimate | Miles driven less the grown estimate |
| Paid route | Estimated route, plus the miles beyond the grown estimate, less the batch type's included miles |
| Mileage owed | Paid route multiplied by the batch type's mileage rate per mile |
| Mileage pay standing | The batch's posted mileage pay, less the reversals booked on the batch on the verified not-delivered ground |
| Amount claimed | Mileage owed less mileage pay standing, rounded once to the cent half up; a negative result is claimed as zero |

## Worked figures (hypothetical batch type: rate 0.50 per mile, 1.0 included mile, tolerance 15 percent)

Estimated route 8.0 miles, 11.0 miles driven, mileage posted 3.50, no reversal:

- grown estimate: 8.0 multiplied by 1.15 is 9.2 miles; 11.0 exceeds it, so a claim arises;
- miles beyond: 11.0 less 9.2 is 1.8;
- paid route: 8.0 plus 1.8 less 1.0 is 8.8 miles;
- mileage owed: 8.8 multiplied by 0.50 is 4.40;
- amount claimed: 4.40 less 3.50 is 0.90.

With the same batch but a reversal of 1.20 booked on the verified not-delivered ground, the pay standing is 2.30 and the amount claimed is 2.10. Had the shopper driven 9.0 miles, 9.0 would not exceed 9.2 and nothing would be claimed.
